findings.summary: completeDelivery and failDelivery do not check if deliveredAt is already set before updating, allowing a worker with an expired lease to overwrite a subsequent successful/failed delivery.
findings.suggested_fix: In completeDelivery and failDelivery, select deliveredAt in the outbox query and return early if outboxRows[0]!.deliveredAt !== null.

findings.summary: The abandonDelivery method is no longer used since it was combined into failDelivery, but it remains in the port interface and adapters.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove abandonDelivery from the PlanRepository interface, PlanStorageAdapter, and FakePlanRepository to keep the port minimal.
